race.comment: SELLICKS BEACH (5) wound up strongly last time out to finish 1.5 lengths adrift in third over 1400m at Bathurst. Will drift back but wind up late. Looks to have plenty of upside and shapes as one to consider. PANELLI (4) was well in commission last start over 1400m at Forbes when seventh, beaten 4 lengths. Winning rider Clayton Gallagher sticks. Where there's smoke there's fire and expecting a better showing. COLLY BLUE (7) brings the right form to this race after taking out a 1100m contest at Forbes last time out by 0.9 lengths. One of the chief contenders. QUASIMOTO (2) was better last start at Dubbo in heavy going and has to be considered on the back of that effort.
